title: Professor(a) de MBA — Automação, Agentes de IA e Vibe Coding
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com experiência prática em automação, agentes de inteligência artificial e desenvolvimento assistido por IA para atuar como professor(a) em nosso MBA em Inteligência Artificial para o Ambiente Corporativo.

O objetivo das disciplinas é ensinar profissionais a identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA dentro das empresas, automatizar processos e desenvolver soluções digitais utilizando ferramentas modernas de inteligência artificial.

Este(a) professor(a) será responsável por duas disciplinas:

  • Automação de Processos, Agentes e Subagentes de IA;
  • Vibe Coding e Criação de Aplicações com IA.

Principais temas

  • Entrevistas com usuários-chave para entendimento do negócio;
  • levantamento de requisitos e regras de negócio;
  • mapeamento de processos;
  • identificação de gargalos e oportunidades de automação;
  • criação e documentação de SOPs;
  • desenho de processos utilizando IA;
  • automação sem código e com pouco código;
  • agentes e subagentes de IA;
  • criação de agentes com OpenClaw;
  • integração entre ferramentas e sistemas;
  • execução e orquestração de tarefas por agentes;
  • segurança e supervisão humana;
  • fundamentos de Vibe Coding;
  • criação de aplicações utilizando linguagem natural;
  • ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA;
  • Claude Code e ferramentas semelhantes;
  • construção de interfaces, dashboards e sistemas internos;
  • integração com APIs e bancos de dados;
  • testes, publicação e manutenção de aplicações.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Experiência prática criando automações e soluções com IA;
  • conhecimento de agentes e arquiteturas agentic;
  • experiência com ferramentas de automação;
  • experiência com ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA;
  • capacidade de mapear problemas de negócio e transformá-los em soluções técnicas;
  • conhecimento de integrações, APIs e sistemas;
  • ótima didática e capacidade de explicar tecnologia para públicos não técnicos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OpenClaw;
  • experiência com Claude Code;
  • experiência com n8n, Make ou ferramentas similares;
  • experiência desenvolvendo agentes e fluxos multiagentes;
  • experiência com projetos de automação dentro de empresas;
  • atuação como AI Engineer, Automation Engineer, AI Solutions Architect ou consultor(a) de IA;
  • experiência ministrando treinamentos ou produzindo conteúdo técnico.
  • O foco da disciplina não será formar engenheiros de software, mas ensinar profissionais a utilizar IA para compreender processos, automatizar operações e criar soluções digitais que resolvam problemas reais das organizações.

Requisitos

  • Ter graduação e pós-graduação (especialização, MBA, mestrado ou doutorado) completa

title: Coordenador(a) de CRM e Lifecycle
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)

Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Coordenador(a) de CRM e Lifecycle para orquestrar o ciclo de vida do usuário da SuperFrete de forma estratégica, do primeiro cadastro à recorrência e fidelização, construindo um relacionamento duradouro com a marca que vai muito além de CRM.

Você vai liderar o time responsável por conectar dados, produto e negócio numa jornada única, respondendo diretamente por métricas centrais da empresa: taxa de ativação (cadastro → postagem), crescimento da base ativa, churn, NPS e representatividade de e-commerce/ICP.

Responsabilidades:

  • Ser dono(a) do resultado da base: ativação, engajamento, retenção, reativação e monetização com metas de receita, LTV e churn;
  • Desenhar e evoluir a estratégia de jornada do usuário (ativação → recorrência → retenção → reativação), conectando-a a receita;
  • Propor e validar frentes de relacionamento além do CRM tradicional, como gamificação, clube de benefícios e outras mecânicas que ainda não existem na SuperFrete;
  • Construir e executar a agenda de experimentação da base: hipóteses próprias, testes A/B, leitura de incrementalidade e escala do que funciona, com monitoramento semanal e capacidade de pivotar rapidamente;
  • Desenhar e operar o ciclo de vida do cliente ponta a ponta nos canais de relacionamento (WhatsApp, push, RCS, e-mail, SMS), com segmentação, personalização e governança de frequência;
  • Investigar causas-raiz de churn e ativação com rigor metodológico (Matriz CSD, pesquisas com usuários, VoC, SPICED) antes de escalar ações;
  • Construir e manter um modelo de atribuição de CRM dentro das jornadas, usando dados para validar (ou derrubar) hipóteses;
  • Manter a jornada perene documentada e atualizada (pipelines, fluxos, réguas), garantindo que o time execute sem depender de você;
  • Atuar na operação e evolução dos processos de Marketing e Vendas no HubSpot, garantindo escalabilidade, governança e qualidade de dados, sem deixar a camada operacional consumir o tempo que deveria ir para a estratégia.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Lifecycle, CRM, Growth ou RevOps;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de pessoas e/ou times multidisciplinares;
  • Visão de negócio consolidada com capacidade de conectar a jornada do usuário a métricas de receita e crescimento;
  • Forte repertório analítico, confortável com dados, modelos de atribuição, RFV e testes A/B;
  • Experiência prática liderando campanhas e automações de CRM multicanal (HubSpot ou similar);
  • Capacidade de transitar entre estratégia e execução, ou seja, pensa a jornada e sabe operacionalizá-la;
  • Perfil de liderança que desenvolve autonomia no time e faz o time comprar a visão, não operar por pressão;
  • Curiosidade genuína por comportamento do consumidor e apetite por testar coisas que ainda não foram feitas aqui. A régua não é replicar o que já existe no mercado, é descobrir o que ainda não existe;
  • Comunicação clara e influência lateral, com maturidade para alinhar áreas sem autoridade direta sobre elas.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em modelos de propensão a churn e segmentação comportamental;
  • Vivência prévia em marketplaces, fintechs, startups de tecnologia ou logística;
  • Experiência com e-commerce e jornadas de ativação de lojistas/vendedores;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Metabase, Looker, Power BI ou Tableau) e/ou SQL;
  • Experiência prática implementando IA/automação aplicada a operações de receita;
  • Vivência com outras ferramentas de CRM/automação além do HubSpot (ex: CleverTap, Braze, RD Station).

O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.

E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete?

title: Creative Content Strategist
description:
Creative Content Strategist | YouTube & Long-Form Video

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week

About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative Creative Content Strategist to take ownership of the strategy and creative direction behind a growing YouTube channel focused on business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and education.

This is a behind-the-scenes creative role. You will be responsible for continuously researching new ideas, developing original video concepts, creating stories and narratives, writing scripts, building storyboards, researching filming locations, and helping shape what each video should look and feel like before the founders step in front of the camera.

The ideal candidate understands YouTube content, storytelling, business, and digital marketing and knows how to turn business expertise into compelling content that people actually want to watch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creative strategy and content planning for the YouTube channel.
  • Research and develop new, original video ideas on an ongoing basis.
  • Study successful YouTube channels and identify formats, storytelling approaches, hooks, and concepts that can be adapted to the brand.
  • Develop compelling video concepts around business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and real-world business stories.
  • Create storylines and narratives that make educational content engaging and entertaining.
  • Write and structure scripts for long-form YouTube videos.
  • Develop storyboards and detailed creative directions for each video.
  • Determine the hook, structure, pacing, key talking points, and overall narrative of each piece.
  • Interview or collaborate with the founders to extract stories, experiences, insights, and expertise that can become strong content.
  • Research interesting entrepreneurs, businesses, trends, case studies, and potential collaboration opportunities.
  • Identify and reach out to potential entrepreneurs or business owners for collaborations and guest appearances.
  • Research visually interesting filming locations in Miami, including hotels, venues, high-rise spaces, businesses, and other unique environments.
  • Provide creative direction for filming setups, locations, environments, and overall visual presentation.
  • Prepare the founders with everything they need before filming so they can execute the content efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the long-form video editor and clearly communicate the intended creative direction.
  • Help establish a repeatable YouTube content production system and maintain an organized content pipeline.
  • Develop approximately one long-form YouTube video per week , with additional shorter long-form content as needed.

Content Focus:

The content will primarily revolve around:

  • Business and entrepreneurship
  • Digital marketing
  • Business growth and strategy
  • Educational content
  • Entrepreneurial stories and interviews
  • Case studies and business lessons
  • Personal branding and founder-led content
  • Interesting business trends and real-world stories

The goal is to create content that educates, entertains, and builds authority, rather than feeling like traditional advertising.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of YouTube content strategy and storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or developing long-form YouTube content.
  • Excellent creative instincts and the ability to consistently generate fresh, original ideas.
  • Strong scripting and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to think visually and imagine how a video should look before it is filmed.
  • Understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, narrative structure, and audience psychology.
  • Strong research skills and curiosity about business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and financial topics.
  • Basic understanding of digital marketing and business concepts.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with founders.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of the creative process.
  • Ability to research and identify interesting filming locations and environments.
  • Comfortable researching and reaching out to entrepreneurs for potential collaborations.
  • Experience with B2B content marketing, educational content, consulting, podcasting, or founder-led content is a plus.
  • A portfolio of YouTube videos or relevant long-form content is required.

Important Role Clarification

Video editing is NOT the primary responsibility of this position.

A dedicated video editor will handle the editing. Your responsibility is to define what should be created and how it should be created—from the initial idea and research through the story, script, storyboard, filming plan, and creative direction.

You will essentially act as the creative director and strategic brain behind the YouTube channel.

You do not need to live in Miami. However, you should be comfortable researching Miami locations remotely using tools such as Google Maps, venue websites, and other online resources.

Experience

We are open to candidates across different experience levels.

A highly experienced YouTube strategist is welcome, but we are equally interested in junior or mid-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional creative thinking, strong storytelling ability, and a genuine understanding of what makes YouTube content compelling.

Your portfolio and creative instincts matter more than a specific number of years of experience.

Schedule

  • Part-Time
  • Approximately 20 hours/week to start
  • Flexible remote schedule
  • Opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the content operation grows

title: Especialista em Tributos
description:
Sobre a LongPing:

A LongPing High-Tech é uma empresa global de sementes, presente em 6 países e está entre uma das líderes do segmento no mercado brasileiro.

Seu portfólio, resultado de investimentos constantes em pesquisa e tecnologia, inclui híbridos que oferecem estabilidade e alto potencial produtivo atendendo com agilidade as necessidades do agricultor.

Com orgulho, somos parte do CITIC Group, o maior conglomerado econômico da China reconhecido pelo mercado pela excelência em produtos e tecnologia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL), garantindo a correta apuração, revisão e reporte dos tributos, em conformidade com a legislação vigente.
  • Conduzir o cálculo do lucro real, incluindo adições, exclusões, compensações e controles fiscais, assegurando consistência entre contabilidade e fiscal.
  • Gerenciar e revisar obrigações acessórias relacionadas aos tributos diretos (ex.: ECF, ECD, PER/DCOMP, entre outras), garantindo qualidade das informações e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Liderar análises e documentações de Transfer Pricing, em conformidade com a legislação brasileira (Lei 14.596/2023) e diretrizes internacionais (OCDE), incluindo suporte a intercompany loans e outras transações vinculadas.
  • Atuar em discussões técnicas complexas, avaliando impactos fiscais de operações, novos negócios, reorganizações societárias e mudanças regulatórias.
  • Estruturar, calcular e suportar a implementação de Juros sobre Capital Próprio (JCP), incluindo modelagem financeira e análise de viabilidade.
  • Avaliar e operacionalizar incentivos fiscais, com destaque para a Lei do Bem, assegurando elegibilidade, documentação e maximização de benefícios.
  • Apoiar processos de fiscalização e contencioso tributário, incluindo preparação de defesas, interação com consultorias externas e autoridades fiscais.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio e liderança, traduzindo temas tributários em impactos financeiros e suportando a tomada de decisão.
  • Monitorar mudanças na legislação tributária e liderar a implementação de ajustes necessários nos processos internos.

Requisitos:

Ensino Superior completo em Contabilidade, Direito, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Sólida experiência em impostos diretos (IRPJ/CSLL) em empresas de médio/grande porte ou consultorias especializadas.

Desejável experiência com Transfer Pricing, incluindo conhecimento da nova legislação brasileira alinhada à OCDE.

Experiência prática com obrigações acessórias (ECF, ECD, PER/DCOMP, entre outras).

Experiência com JCP e incentivos fiscais (Lei do Bem) será considerada diferencial relevante.

Conhecimento avançado em lucro real, controles fiscais e reconciliação entre contábil e fiscal.

Conhecimento em contencioso tributário e interação com auditorias e fiscalizações.

Desejável conhecimento nos sistemas Taxone e SAP.

Inglês avançado.

Oportunidade e Inclusão:

Nós da LongPing, buscamos promover a inclusão e incentivamos que profissionais com deficiência se inscrevam diretamente nas vagas divulgadas que tenham interesse, dentre todas as oportunidades oferecidas.

A LongPing agradece o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Head of Sales and Business Development
description:
Sales & Business Development Leader – LATAM

Location: Brazil | Work Model: Remote

Region: Latin America (LATAM)

About the Company

Our client is a global innovator in high-performance polymer and flash-spun material technologies , providing advanced material solutions across industrial protection, healthcare, technical textiles, semiconductor, packaging, and sustainable applications.

Driven by innovation and scalable manufacturing capabilities, the company delivers application-oriented B2B solutions to customers worldwide through established industrial and distribution networks.

As part of its global expansion, the company is now building its presence across Latin America and is looking for an entrepreneurial commercial leader to establish and grow the regional business.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Sales & Business Development Leader based in Brazil to lead the development of the company's protective garments and apparel business across LATAM.

The role will focus on both branded material solutions used in protective garment manufacturing and a portfolio of finished protective clothing . The successful candidate will combine strong industry knowledge with commercial and technical capabilities, helping customers identify the right solutions based on performance, regulatory, application, and supply chain requirements.

As the first commercial hire in LATAM , this is a highly entrepreneurial role. The successful candidate will be expected to build the market from the ground up — identifying opportunities, developing customer relationships, establishing distribution channels, supporting product trials, and converting opportunities into sustainable revenue.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Market Building

  • Develop and execute the LATAM business development strategy for protective apparel, disposable garments, PPE, and technical clothing.
  • Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, PPE brands, and end users .
  • Build the company's customer and partner network across key LATAM markets.
  • Identify target accounts, applications, market segments, and new routes to market.
  • Establish and expand the company's presence and brand recognition in the regional protective apparel market.
  • Develop the business from an early-stage market position, taking ownership from lead generation through to commercial execution.

2. Portfolio Sales

  • Promote and sell branded high-performance materials used in the production of protective garments.
  • Develop sales of the company's finished protective garment portfolio.
  • Understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate solution based on performance, application, regulatory, cost, and supply chain considerations .
  • Develop commercial proposals, negotiate with customers, and manage the sales cycle through to closure.
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular forecasts and market updates.

3. Technical & Application Support

  • Advise customers on material selection and protective garment performance requirements.
  • Support technical discussions relating to fabric performance, barrier properties, material selection, garment construction, and manufacturing processes .
  • Work closely with customers and internal technical teams on product trials, testing, qualification, and garment evaluations.
  • Translate customer requirements into practical material and product solutions.
  • Support customers through product evaluation, qualification, and onboarding.

4. Market Development & Intelligence

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer needs, and regulatory developments across LATAM.
  • Identify emerging applications and growth opportunities within protective clothing, disposable garments, PPE, and technical textiles.
  • Develop market intelligence and provide actionable insights to global product, R&D, and commercial teams.
  • Identify opportunities for new products, applications, partnerships, and market entry strategies.
  • Represent the company at relevant industry events, exhibitions, and customer forums.

5. Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Build long-term relationships with garment manufacturers, distributors, PPE brands, procurement teams, and key end users.
  • Conduct customer visits, product presentations, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations.
  • Develop strong relationships across technical, procurement, commercial, and senior management levels.
  • Support customers throughout product evaluation, qualification, implementation, and ongoing business development.
  • Develop and manage strategic distributors and channel partners where appropriate.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with global sales, marketing, product development, R&D, technical, operations, and supply chain teams.
  • Bring LATAM customer and market requirements into global product and commercial discussions.
  • Coordinate customer projects and ensure effective follow-up from opportunity identification through commercialization.

Requirements

Experience & Technical Knowledge

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant sales or business development experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Protective garments / protective apparel
  • Disposable apparel
  • PPE products
  • Technical textiles
  • Nonwoven materials
  • High-performance materials used in protective clothing
  • Proven experience working with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, PPE brands, or industrial end users .
  • Good understanding of materials used in protective clothing, including nonwovens, laminates, technical fabrics, polymers, or barrier materials .
  • Understanding of protective clothing standards, certification, and performance requirements is highly desirable.
  • Experience selling finished protective garments or PPE products is a strong advantage.
  • Technical knowledge of textiles, materials science, polymer engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Commercial Capabilities

  • Strong track record in B2B sales and business development , preferably within technical or engineered products.
  • Ability to develop new markets and generate business from a relatively low existing customer base.
  • Strong consultative selling and solution-selling capabilities.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable engaging with both technical stakeholders and senior commercial/procurement decision-makers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand customer economics and supply chain requirements.

Languages

  • Fluent English is required.
  • Portuguese is required for the Brazil-based role.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially driven, and comfortable operating in a build-up environment .

As the company's first commercial hire in LATAM, this person will not simply manage an existing customer base. They will be expected to build the business from scratch — identify prospects, open doors, develop relationships, create opportunities, support technical evaluations, establish channels, and ultimately generate sustainable revenue.

The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of protective garments and technical textiles with strong commercial execution , enabling the company's branded materials and protective clothing solutions to become preferred solutions for customers across multiple industries.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership and operates with a high level of autonomy.
  • Is comfortable being hands-on across the entire sales cycle .
  • Has a strong hunter mentality and enjoys opening new markets.
  • Can build relationships from scratch and turn technical discussions into commercial opportunities.
  • Is technically credible with customers while remaining commercially focused.
  • Is willing to travel extensively across LATAM as the business develops.
  • Can work effectively with a global organization and multicultural teams.
  • Is excited by the opportunity to build something new and create the foundation for the company's LATAM business .

What Makes This Opportunity Attractive?

  • First commercial hire in LATAM with significant ownership and visibility.
  • Opportunity to build a regional business from the ground up .
  • Exposure to innovative high-performance polymer and advanced material technologies.
  • Direct interaction with global commercial, technical, and R&D teams.
  • Broad responsibility covering business development, sales, technical application, and market development.
  • Opportunity to shape the company's LATAM go-to-market strategy and long-term regional growth .
  • Remote-based position in Brazil with significant regional responsibility.

title: Operations Analyst - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Operations Analyst position focuses on providing analytical support to commercial operations. This role combines data analysis with process improvement to identify trends, create insightful reports, and collaborate across teams while developing analytical skills in a global environment.

Key responsibilities:

- Evaluate operational data to uncover trends, process gaps, and improvement opportunities.

- Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and key operational performance indicators.

- Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze and enhance business processes.

- Assist in project execution and continuous process optimization initiatives.

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfield is engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach to the brand called Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from

adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

Para tornar esse propósito realidade, atuamos em duas frentes complementares: educação financeira e gestão de investimentos . MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

Job Purpose

Execute routine inspections and predictive/preventive maintenance activities on topside systems and equipment, ensuring safe and reliable operations in accordance with company procedures, permit-to-work requirements, and supervisor instructions.

Perform routine rounds throughout the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance and report abnormal conditions.

Somos uma plataforma de duplo motor: de um lado, estruturamos e operamos capital em veículos de investimento imobiliário; do outro, operamos a LUIH , nossa marca no mercado americano, incorporadora e construtora de casas de luxo em Orlando, Flórida. Se você é organizado(a), proativo(a) e gosta de transformar desafios em ótimas experiências para o cliente, essa posição é para você.

  • Ser o principal ponto de contato dos homeowners para dúvidas e solicitações de garantia.

  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito). Espanhol é um diferencial forte.

Por Que se Juntar a Nós

Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer em um ambiente de desafios reais, onde ownership não é discurso, é como trabalhamos todos os dias. Valorizamos o incentivo a tomar decisões conscientes, assumir responsabilidade pelo que entrega e enxergar cada desafio como oportunidade de desenvolvimento.

Acreditamos em cortar a complexidade e simplificar processos, sem nunca perder o foco no que realmente importa: a experiência do cliente. Como Warranty Service Representative, você estará na linha de frente dessa entrega, construindo confiança, resolvendo problemas com agilidade e fazendo parte de uma empresa que está em plena construção da sua cultura e dos seus processos.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: CPO/Product Manager

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

We recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to own how Nova shows up for its customers, from the first support message to the public review that comes after it.

This role goes beyond basic ticket handling. Our first line of support is an AI agent, and a big part of your role is making it better every week: finding where it fails, feeding it the right answers, and stepping in yourself when a human is genuinely needed.

You'll own everything around it — our reputation on the App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, proactive outreach when a customer’s situation calls for it, and bringing what you hear back to Product and Marketing so we fix the root cause.

You’ll be the voice of the customer inside a small, fast-moving fintech team, with real ownership from day one.

This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Is genuinely obsessed with customer satisfaction
  • Uses AI to work better and faster, not just because it’s trendy
  • Wants to build a support operation, not just staff one

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop our AI support agent: continuously improve the AI agent that handles our first line of support — reviewing conversations, identifying gaps and failure cases, refining answers and knowledge base content, and raising the share of cases resolved without human help;
  • Handle escalations: personally respond to the cases where a human is required, with care, accuracy and speed;
  • Own our public reputation: monitor and respond across App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, and be accountable for our scores and response times on those channels;
  • Proactive outreach: reach out directly to customers in specific situations — failed payments, incidents, high-value or at-risk users — before they have to come to us;
  • Lead the Monthly Customer Support Meeting: prepare the data, surface the main pain points and trends, and drive follow-ups to completion;
  • Work side-by-side with Product Managers and Marketing: turn support signal into product fixes and clearer communication, and make sure customer-facing messaging matches what customers actually experience;
  • Keep things organized: support macros, help center content, processes and metrics — documented and up to date.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • Obsessed with customer satisfaction — you take it personally when someone has a bad experience;
  • Excellent Portuguese writing & communication skills — clear, warm and firm in the same message;
  • Great verbal communication — comfortable on the phone, on a call, and in front of the team. You'll be leading initiatives and reporting;
  • Comfortable with English (intermediate is enough — we work internally in English);
  • AI Native and Enthusiast: you already use AI tools to make your own work better and more efficient (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), and you’re excited about shaping an AI agent rather than competing with it;
  • Organized and autonomous — you can own a process end to end without being chased;
  • Strong team player, curious and proactive.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in customer support, customer success or customer experience — ideally in fintech, banking or a high-volume consumer app;
  • Familiarity with support tooling (Intercom, Zendesk or similar) and reputation channels (ReclameAqui, app store reviews);
  • Comfort with data: able to pull, read and present support metrics (volume, CSAT, first response time, resolution rate);
  • Experience dealing with sensitive topics — payments, charges, fraud, disputes;
  • Fast learner who thrives in dynamic, ambitious environments.

How You Work

  • Collaborative: open, communicative, team-oriented
  • Customer-obsessed: you listen closely and follow through
  • AI Native: you automate the repetitive so you can focus on what matters
  • Ambitious: eager to grow quickly and deliver impact
  • Owner mindset: you fix the root cause, not just the ticket

Other Requirements

  • Location: 3x per week (Tue, Wed, Thu) at our office in São Paulo
  • English mandatory

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Inside Sales - Especialista de Produtos | Mesa RF/RV
description:
Sobre a Quark

Somos uma assessoria de investimentos credenciada pelo Banco Safra — a solidez de um banco com mais de 180 anos somada à agilidade de uma assessoria. Em poucos anos, passamos de R$1 bilhão sob custódia, com cerca de 70 assessores e mais de 3.000 clientes. Fomos eleitos Revelação Safra em 2024 e estamos entre os três melhores escritórios da rede.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos alguém com perfil comercial para ser a ponte entre os nossos assessores de investimentos e as áreas de produto da Quark. Na prática, você ajuda os assessores a levarem as soluções certas para os clientes deles — renda variável, renda fixa, seguros, consórcios e outros produtos —, identificando oportunidades e conduzindo cada uma até o fechamento.

É uma posição para quem gosta de vender, de trabalhar próximo de gente e de fazer negócio acontecer.

O que você vai fazer

  • Gerar oportunidades: identificar e desenvolver negócios junto aos assessores, olhando as carteiras deles em busca de demandas de produto.
  • Conectar assessor e produto: ser o elo entre a rede de assessores e as áreas internas (renda variável, seguros, consórcios, entre outros).
  • Vender de forma consultiva: apresentar cada solução de um jeito claro e ligado à necessidade real do cliente.
  • Cuidar do pipeline: controlar o funil de ponta a ponta, acompanhando cada oportunidade até a conversão.
  • Manter proximidade: conduzir os follow-ups e manter um canal aberto e constante com os assessores.

O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência comercial: vivência em vendas, áreas comerciais ou no mercado financeiro.
  • Comunicação clara: você se expressa bem na fala e na escrita, e sabe ouvir.
  • Perfil de vendas: gosto por resultado e disciplina para conduzir o pipeline.
  • Relacionamento: facilidade para criar confiança e negociar, com organização no dia a dia.
  • Base técnica: conhecimento de produtos financeiros (renda fixa, renda variável, seguros).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em corretoras, bancos de investimento ou plataformas abertas.
  • Boa desenvoltura com CRM.
  • Certificação ANCORD ativa.

title: Gerente de Vendas | Interlagos
description:
Falar da MRV&CO (MRV, Urba, Luggo, Sensia e Resia) é dizer muito mais do que os títulos que recebemos durante nossa história de 46 anos . Ser uma das maiores construtoras da América Latina nos orgulha muito. Mas não só isso! Queremos mais e ir além! Somos uma Companhia inovadora e incansável na busca de soluções de moradia. Nos desafiamos e acreditamos na nossa força. E é importante que se evidencie: a força da MRV&CO está em nossa gente. Uma Gente com G maiúsculo , engajada, protagonista, transformadora. Em poucas palavras: um time Sangue Verde!

Acreditamos na transparência das relações, na valorização das conquistas e não abrimos mão dos valores que nos trouxeram até aqui. Temos certeza de que dia após dia construímos o futuro que queremos e esse futuro se apresenta em nosso propósito: construir sonhos que transformam o mundo.

Vem #SERSangueVerde com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará na área Comercial como Gerente de loja, sendo responsável por realizar a gestão de pessoas no dia-a-dia, selecionando, treinando e desenvolvendo a equipe constantemente. Além de fazer a gestão administrativa do ponto de vendas, mantendo a estrutura e controlando as despesas. Algumas das suas atividades são:

  • Apoiar em reuniões periódicas de equipe;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de mídias;
  • Apoiar na negociação de vendas com clientes;
  • Participar da análise de produtividade da equipe de vendas;
  • Participar de treinamentos para aperfeiçoamento da equipe de vendas;
  • Organizar e promover a rotina diária da equipe de vendas;
  • Coordenar e acompanhar o fluxo dos contratos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo;
  • Pacote office;
  • Experiência como líder comercial no mercado imobiliário, será indispensável;
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e engajamento de pessoas;
  • Habilidade para análises de mercado;
  • Capacidade de influência;
  • Disciplina;
  • Organização.

Informações adicionais

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Comissão sobre vendas;
  • Benefício de alimentação flexível (vale-refeição e/ou vale-alimentação);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa anual de remuneração variável;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • TotalPass;
  • Benefícios, conforme convenção coletiva de trabalho;
  • E muito mais!

O que é preciso para criar um mundo extraordinário?

Mais do que casas, queremos construir respostas. Já somos mais de 30 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos, engajados na busca por um futuro melhor para todos e todas.

Acreditamos que diversidade e inclusão são componentes essenciais para o crescimento da sociedade, além de serem fatores essenciais para a sustentabilidade do nosso negócio. Queremos estimular um ambiente seguro, diverso e inclusivo em que todas as pessoas tenham oportunidades iguais para crescer e evoluir. Para chegar lá, nossas ações são voltadas para garantir a:

• Equidade de gêneros ⚧

• Equidade racial ✊

• Diversidade de gêneros e orientações sexuais ️

Transformar a sociedade é um grande desafio. Mas, juntos, é possível. Faça parte de um grupo com o olhar para o futuro, mas que acredita que as transformações que queremos para o amanhã devem começar hoje.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Company Description deepidv is redefining human and AI verification with a proprietary, end-to-end engine and agentic compliance suite built for modern risk, fraud prevention, and continuous monitoring. The platform replaces legacy, API-stitched identity solutions with a single stack that combines Human + AI decisioning, cryptographic proof, and always-on risk and compliance controls. Every verification is triple-encrypted, auditable, and explainable, ensuring that people, documents, and moments of capture are provably real. deepidv operates across 211+ countries without third-party middlemen and is also the team behind UAIIP (Universal AI Identity Protocol) at getai.id, which establishes verifiable identities for AI companions. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and founded by a team with multiple successful exits in fintech and retail.

Role Description The Social Media Content Creator at deepidv is a full-time, remote role responsible for developing and executing content that grows brand awareness and engagement across social platforms. In this role, you will plan and produce short-form and long-form content (posts, threads, videos, carousels), translating complex topics like AI, cryptography, and risk/compliance into accessible, compelling narratives. You will manage daily posting schedules, community interactions, and real-time engagement, including replies, DMs, and comment moderation. You will collaborate with marketing, product, and leadership to align content with key launches, thought leadership, and go-to-market priorities, while monitoring analytics to refine messaging, formats, and channels. You will also stay current on social trends in AI, security, and fintech to propose new content concepts and experiments that elevate deepidv’s voice in the market.

Qualifications

  • Strong social media content creation and storytelling skills, including experience crafting platform-native content for channels such as X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and TikTok.
  • Ability to translate technical or complex topics (AI, identity, security, cryptography, compliance) into clear, engaging, and accurate narratives for varied audiences.
  • Experience with social media strategy, content planning, and editorial calendars, including campaign-based and always-on content.
  • Proficiency with basic design and multimedia tools (e.g., Canva, Figma, or similar), and comfort collaborating with design or video partners.
  • Skill in community management, including handling comments, DMs, and online discussions in a professional, inclusive, and brand-aligned manner.
  • Familiarity with social analytics tools and metrics (engagement, reach, CTR, follower growth) to inform iteration and reporting.
  • Excellent written communication skills in English, with meticulous attention to tone, clarity, and accuracy.

title: Full Cycle Account Executive
description:
Full-time | Remote from LATAM | USD 30-48K / year base + performance-based commissions  

Position Overview  

Upstart AEC is seeking a Full-Cycle Account Executive for a full-time, fully remote opportunity supporting a fast-growing Gen Z marketing and lead-generation platform. 

This is a true hunter-closer role . You will own the sales process from initial prospecting through signed contract, selling a differentiated marketing channel to CMOs, Marketing Directors, and Heads of Growth at mid-sized U.S. companies . 

While an SDR team provides some support, you will be expected to self-source the majority of your pipeline through outbound activity. The ideal candidate is highly motivated by results, comfortable operating independently, and able to demonstrate a consistent history of quota attainment with clear performance metrics. 

Key Responsibilities  

  • Own the complete sales cycle from prospecting and cold outreach through discovery, negotiation, and close. 
  • Build the majority of your own pipeline through email, LinkedIn, cold calling, and other outbound strategies. 
  • Identify and engage senior marketing decision-makers at U.S.-based companies. 
  • Conduct consultative discovery conversations to understand customer acquisition challenges and marketing priorities. 
  • Position the solution using performance marketing metrics such as CPL, CPA, customer acquisition cost, and LTV . 
  • Navigate multiple stakeholders throughout a typical 4–7 month sales cycle . 
  • Maintain an accurate, organized CRM with clear pipeline stages, next steps, and forecasting. 
  • Consistently achieve or exceed individual sales targets. 
  • Use structured, scalable prospecting approaches to maintain strong outbound activity and pipeline generation. 
  • Operate independently in a fully remote environment while maintaining clear communication and accountability. 

Required Skills  

  • Proven full-cycle Account Executive experience , including both prospecting and closing. 
  • Demonstrated quota attainment with specific, measurable performance results. 
  • Proven experience personally sourcing and closing outbound opportunities. 
  • Experience selling to CMOs, Marketing Directors, Heads of Growth, or similar marketing buyers . 
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing concepts including CPL, CPA, CAC, and LTV . 
  • Experience managing consultative B2B sales processes involving multiple stakeholders. 
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills across email, LinkedIn, and cold calling. 
  • Business-level English fluency, with the ability to confidently sell and negotiate with senior U.S. executives. 
  • Experience maintaining accurate pipelines and forecasting through CRM systems. 
  • Comfortable generating pipeline independently rather than relying primarily on inbound or SDR-generated opportunities. 
  • Strong autonomy, resilience, and ability to perform in a fast-moving remote environment. 
  • Availability to work primarily within Western Hemisphere time zones . 

Nice-to-Have Skills  

  • Experience in MarTech, SaaS, digital advertising, or B2B marketing services . 
  • Experience selling platforms or marketing channels where the economic buyer is part of a marketing organization. 
  • Familiarity with modern prospecting and data-enrichment tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or Clay . 
  • Experience selling into the U.S. market and strong familiarity with U.S. business culture. 
  • Experience using asynchronous collaboration tools and processes in remote organizations. 
  • Ability to understand a prospect's existing digital acquisition strategy and confidently challenge or reframe their approach.

#GrupoSADA #DevaVeículos #Vagas #Oportunidade #AnalistaComercial #Comercial #Vendas #SetorAutomotivo #VeículosPesados #Carreira

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli , fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: Advertising Media Buyer
description:
Meta Media Buyer (Facebook & Instagram Ads)

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based marketing and growth agency that partners with local businesses and performance-driven brands across multiple industries. Their focus is on paid media, creative testing, lead generation, and full-funnel growth strategies, helping clients scale through data-driven marketing and continuous optimization.

They are seeking a talented Meta Media Buyer to join their team and support the growth of their client portfolio.

Role Overview

As a Meta Media Buyer, you will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and scaling Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns for a variety of clients. This is a highly analytical and strategic role that requires strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads, performance marketing, audience targeting, creative testing, and campaign optimization.

You will work closely with internal teams and clients to identify growth opportunities, improve campaign performance, and drive measurable business results.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building, launching, and optimizing Meta advertising campaigns.
  • Managing campaign budgets and performance targets.
  • Developing audience targeting and retargeting strategies.
  • Conducting creative testing and performance analysis.
  • Monitoring key metrics such as CPA, CPL, ROAS, CTR, CPM, and conversion rates.
  • Presenting insights and recommendations to clients.
  • Collaborating with creative and strategy teams to improve results.
  • Staying current with Meta platform updates and industry best practices.

Logistics

  • Part-time to start, with strong potential to transition into a full-time role.
  • U.S. business hours (primarily EST)
  • Long-term opportunity with growth potential

Requirements

Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience managing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager.
  • Experience with lead generation and/or e-commerce campaigns.
  • Proven ability to optimize campaigns based on performance data.
  • Experience with audience segmentation, retargeting, lookalike audiences, and Advantage+ campaigns.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience working directly with clients and presenting campaign results.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Google Ads, or LinkedIn Ads.
  • Experience with GA4, Shopify, Looker Studio, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar reporting platforms.

title: SBS Operations Senior Manager
description:
At Sherwin-Williams, we color the world! With more than 150 years of global excellence, we are a leader in the paints and coatings industry, recognized for innovation, quality, and our commitment to sustainability.

We are seeking an experienced SBS Operations Senior Manager to lead and advance our Shared Business Services operations across Brazil. This role partners closely with SBS Service Delivery teams and business leaders to drive service excellence, operational effectiveness, and strategic growth.

The SBS Operations Senior Manager plays a critical role in overseeing regional service delivery, managing demand pipelines, capacity planning, service placement strategies, and supporting key SBS initiatives across Brazil. This leader will also be responsible for monitoring and improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring the organization consistently delivers high-quality, efficient, and scalable services. Beyond operational leadership, this role is empowered to drive transformation through influence, collaboration, communication, and execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will champion process standardization, harmonization, optimization, and automation, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, strong governance, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who thrives in complex environments, builds strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, and is passionate about developing high-performing teams while driving meaningful business impact across Brazil and LATAM.

São Bernardo do Campo, SP, Brazil | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

  1. Build and manage regional processes, business requirements, documentation, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories. Manage and continuously enhance SBS processes within the service catalog, including the evaluation of current services, regional systems, taxonomies, tools, business process master lists, and repository governance.
  2. Lead the execution of the regional transition program , focusing on process standardization, harmonization, streamlining, optimization, and control analysis. Partner closely with SBS Service Delivery teams to identify, design, and implement process improvement initiatives and supporting tools.
  3. Prepare and manage the facility budget , process facility-related charges, and monitor expenditures throughout the year to ensure proper financial oversight and cost control.
  4. Partner with SBS leadership to build the foundation for the organization and support its continued growth and maturity, driving sustainable operational capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
  5. Execute regional transition initiatives to ensure smooth service transfers, effective stakeholder alignment, and seamless handoffs between teams.
  6. Develop and implement programs that strengthen operational excellence capabilities , including the assessment, design, and deployment of training initiatives. Promote consistent ways of working, cross-functional collaboration, waste reduction, process standardization, and risk mitigation.
  7. Serve as a senior influencer across global, regional, and local leadership teams. Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized SBS processes and operating models. Build strong partnerships across Finance, SBS, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, while effectively communicating vision, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  8. Build and develop high-performing teams across LATAM. Drive initiatives that enhance operational excellence capabilities, professional development, and organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced professional certification.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, Shared Services, Operations, or a related business function, with a proven track record in operational excellence, process management, transformation, and business partnership.
  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Spanish proficiency is preferred.
  • Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, build cross-functional relationships, and drive alignment across global, regional, and local teams.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams both directly and through influence in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC), multinational organization, or business transformation environment is highly desirable.
  • Previous people leadership experience and exposure to transition management, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives are preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end business processes, including areas such as Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Hire-to-Retire (HTR), and other Shared Services processes.

  • Experience developing execution strategies, operating procedures, governance models, and process documentation.
  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, process standardization, and operational excellence principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Shared Services technologies, workflow tools, automation solutions, and ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience supporting automation, digital transformation, or process optimization initiatives.

About Us

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life ... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to improve your health and well-being.

title: Amazon Account Strategist
description:
Nova Ecommerce Group is a strategy-first marketplace growth agency helping consumer brands scale profitably across Amazon and other leading ecommerce platforms.

We go beyond basic account management and advertising execution. Our team works closely with brand leaders to improve the entire marketplace P&L—from revenue growth and advertising efficiency to conversion, pricing, inventory, promotions, and contribution margin.

We are hiring an experienced Amazon Account Strategist to own the strategic direction and commercial performance of a portfolio of consumer brands.

The Role

The Amazon Account Strategist serves as the strategic partner for each assigned client. You will translate business objectives into actionable marketplace strategies, align Nova’s internal specialists around the highest-impact priorities, and ensure our work produces measurable improvements in revenue and profitability.

This is not a task-management or client-service-only role. You must be comfortable analyzing a digital marketplace P&L, diagnosing the factors affecting performance, making commercially sound recommendations, and communicating those recommendations confidently to founders and brand executives.

The ideal candidate understands how Amazon’s interconnected levers—including traffic, conversion, advertising, pricing, promotions, content, inventory, reviews, organic ranking, and operational health—affect the overall financial performance of a consumer brand.

Key ResponsibilitiesAccount Strategy and P&L Ownership
  • Own the strategic direction and performance of a portfolio of Amazon accounts.
  • Evaluate revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, TACOS, advertising spend, fees, promotions, returns, and other major P&L drivers.
  • Build annual, quarterly, and monthly growth plans based on historical performance, category opportunity, seasonality, inventory, and profitability targets.
  • Identify the root causes of performance gaps and prioritize the initiatives most likely to improve profitable growth.
  • Develop SKU-level strategies based on demand, margin, lifecycle stage, competitive position, and inventory availability.
  • Identify expansion opportunities involving new products, variations, bundles, marketplaces, and adjacent sales channels.
Performance Analysis
  • Analyze account and category data to understand changes in traffic, conversion rate, average selling price, advertising efficiency, organic rank, market share, and profitability.
  • Interpret Amazon data sources such as Business Reports, Search Query Performance, Brand Analytics, advertising reports, inventory reports, and category intelligence tools.
  • Distinguish meaningful trends from normal volatility and translate data into clear business decisions.
  • Monitor pacing against forecasts and recommend corrective action when an account is behind plan.
  • Partner with advertising specialists to ensure PPC strategy supports the account’s broader commercial objectives.
  • Review performance at the SKU, campaign, keyword, query, and portfolio levels without losing sight of the overall P&L.
Client Leadership
  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to brand founders and leaders.
  • Lead recurring client meetings with a clear point of view on performance, risks, priorities, and next steps.
  • Present complex marketplace data in concise, commercially relevant language.
  • Set realistic expectations regarding growth, investment, inventory, profitability, and timing.
  • Proactively identify risks before they become client-facing problems.
  • Build trust through strong judgment, transparency, preparation, and consistent follow-through.
  • Challenge client assumptions constructively when the data supports a different course of action.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Translate account strategy into clear priorities for Nova’s PPC, content, design, catalog, inventory, and operations specialists.
  • Ensure internal execution remains aligned with the client’s financial goals and highest-impact opportunities.
  • Create clear briefs, assign measurable outcomes, and maintain accountability for deliverables.
  • Review work for strategic alignment and quality before it reaches the client.
  • Help resolve competing priorities across advertising, inventory, creative, pricing, and promotions.
  • Contribute frameworks, insights, and best practices that strengthen Nova’s broader account-management organization.
Required Experience
  • Significant experience managing the digital marketplace P&L of consumer brands, whether at an ecommerce agency, as a consultant, or in a brand leadership role.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for both revenue growth and profitability—not advertising metrics alone.
  • Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Ads.
  • Experience developing and executing marketplace growth strategies for consumer products.
  • Ability to analyze revenue, margin, advertising, conversion, inventory, pricing, and promotional data.
  • Experience forecasting sales and translating forecasts into advertising, inventory, and operational plans.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple brands or business units with different goals and commercial realities.
  • Experience communicating directly with founders, executives, or senior brand stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience managing Amazon accounts generating seven figures or more in annual marketplace revenue.
  • Agency experience overseeing a portfolio of consumer brands.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Sellerboard, Helium 10, Data Dive, SmartScout, or comparable analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Walmart Marketplace, TikTok Shop, or other ecommerce channels.
  • Experience leading product launches, marketplace turnarounds, international expansion, or profitability-improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with contribution-margin modeling, inventory planning, and demand forecasting.
  • Experience working with creative, catalog, advertising, and operations teams in a remote environment.
What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon Account Strategist at Nova:

  • Develops a deep understanding of each client’s business model, products, margins, goals, and constraints.
  • Creates clear strategies that connect Amazon activity to revenue and contribution profit.
  • Consistently identifies the few actions most likely to create meaningful commercial impact.
  • Maintains accurate forecasts and responds quickly when performance deviates from plan.
  • Improves client confidence, retention, and satisfaction through proactive strategic leadership.
  • Keeps internal teams focused, aligned, and accountable.
  • Brings thoughtful recommendations to clients rather than simply reporting what happened.
  • Helps assigned brands achieve sustainable, profitable marketplace growth.
How to Apply

Please email your résumé and a brief explanation of your relevant marketplace P&L experience to with the subject line “Amazon Account Strategist Application – (Your Name).”

Compensation: $3,000–$4,000 USD per month, based on experience, with performance-based bonus potential.

title: Plant Operations Manager
description:
About Teknia – We are a multinational industrial company specialising in manufacturing metal and plastic components for mobility. Founded in 1992, we operate 21 production plants across 11 countries and employ more than 3,500 professionals. By combining a wide range of technologies, we collaborate with the leading manufacturers in the global automotive sector.

We are the sum of our factories and the people who make them possible. A growing company that has evolved thanks to the commitment and talent of our people.

About the Position – We are looking to hire an Industrialization Manager to join our team in our TEPEJI DEL RIO PLANT (MEXICO) .

The selected candidate will lead operations and capital investment projects while ensuring plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements. They will drive operational excellence across the plant, guaranteeing the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets in line with customer expectations and business objectives. The role will also be responsible for promoting continuous improvement initiatives, operational efficiency, and compliance with automotive industry standards.

The responsibilities of the position include:

  • Lead small, medium, and large-scale industrialization and capital investment projects using project management methodologies.
  • Ensure plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements.
  • Coordinate production line modifications and engineering change management activities.
  • Manage contractors, suppliers, and internal resources involved in projects.
  • Control project budgets, capital expenditures, and investment execution.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, suppliers, and customers to achieve project and operational objectives.
  • Lead plant operations, ensuring compliance with production schedules and operational targets.
  • Drive the implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, and TPM initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with automotive quality standards, including IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, and SPC.
  • Lead audits and oversee corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Promote a strong safety culture, cost control, and talent development across the organization.
  • Monitor and improve operational KPIs to enhance plant performance and competitiveness.

Experience and Education

  • Academic Background: Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. A Master's Degree is considered an advantage.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar leadership role and 8-10 years of experience within the automotive industry.
  • Proven experience managing plant operations, preferably within Die Casting and Machining environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Continuous Improvement methodologies, KPI management, and Project Management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing large-scale industrialization projects.
  • Language Skills: Fluent English.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to operational challenges.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

If you're looking for a dynamic environment and a project with international scope, Teknia is the ideal place for you . We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:

title: Tax Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Fiscal Tax Specialist serves as the primary technical expert for all tax-related matters, ensuring the company's full tax compliance while identifying opportunities for tax optimization, mitigating tax risks, and guaranteeing the accurate calculation, reporting, and payment of taxes. This position plays a strategic role in aligning tax practices with current legislation and the company's business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure the accurate calculation, review, and timely submission of all tax returns and ancillary tax obligations.
  • Maintain compliance with federal, state, and municipal tax regulations.
  • Monitor changes in tax legislation and assess their impact on company operations.
  • Develop and maintain internal controls to ensure tax compliance and minimize tax exposure.
  • Serve as the technical lead during internal and external audits related to tax matters.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Tax/Fiscal functions.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Tax Specialist or senior tax advisory role.

  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Protheus ERP
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • SPED Fiscal
  • EFD Contributions
  • ECD (Digital Accounting Bookkeeping)
  • ECF (Digital Tax Accounting Bookkeeping)
  • Experience with tax audits, tax recovery projects, and tax planning initiatives.

Key Competencies

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen.
  • Ability to interpret and apply complex tax legislation.
  • Project management and process improvement capabilities.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Operations teams.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sobre a WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Onde o fornecimento começa

Fundada em 1999, a WIN SOURCE ajuda fabricantes a garantir componentes eletrônicos críticos e a construir cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes em um mercado global cada vez mais complexo, com o apoio de uma equipe global de mais de 450 colaboradores.

Atualmente, a WIN SOURCE atende clientes em todo o mundo por meio de operações estrategicamente localizadas na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte, instalações certificadas e um forte compromisso com a qualidade, a confiabilidade e a excelência operacional.

title: Consultant/Consultante
description:
Analista CQV Sênior – Equipamentos | Jaguariúna, SP

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista CQV Sênior para atuar em um projeto de alta complexidade no setor farmacêutico, na região de Jaguariúna, São Paulo .

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em CQV e qualificação de equipamentos , capaz de atuar de forma autônoma em projetos GMP.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar, revisar e executar protocolos de IQ, OQ e PQ .
  • Atuar na qualificação de equipamentos e sistemas de processo .
  • Elaborar documentação de CQV: protocolos, relatórios, análises de risco e rastreabilidade.
  • Acompanhar atividades de comissionamento e qualificação em campo .
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Engenharia, Qualidade, Produção e Projetos.
  • Apoiar o tratamento de desvios, CAPAs e Change Controls relacionados a CQV.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos GMP/BPF .

Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em CQV, Validação ou Comissionamento.
  • Experiência na indústria farmacêutica, biotecnológica ou Life Sciences .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em CQV e qualificação de equipamentos .
  • Experiência prática com IQ/OQ/PQ .
  • Conhecimento de GMP/BPF .
  • Perfil sênior, hands-on e autônomo.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com equipamentos de processo e sistemas críticos .
  • Conhecimento de HVAC, PW, WFI, Clean Steam, CIP/SIP , entre outros.
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação ou expansão de plantas farmacêuticas.

Local: Região de Jaguariúna – SP

Se você possui 10+ anos de experiência em CQV e conhecimentos aprofundados em qualificação de equipamentos , entre em contato ou candidate-se à vaga.

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Job Purpose

Execute instrumentation maintenance activities onboard, ensuring the reliability, operability, and safety of instrumentation systems through predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance in compliance with planned maintenance systems and operational procedures.

Responsibilities

Execute predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance on instrumentation systems in accordance with work orders and supervisor instructions.

Perform interventions on onboard instrumentation systems to ensure compliance with the planned maintenance program.

Provide technical support during equipment, system, and production start-ups, planned shutdowns, and operational activities.

Monitor and support third-party service providers performing instrumentation work onboard.

Assist in troubleshooting instrumentation failures to ensure safe and reliable operations.

Support emergency response activities, including supervising tasks and coordinating with third-party representatives when required.

Perform all activities in accordance with company procedures, SOPs, and safety requirements.

Requirements

Technical Degree in Instrumentation, Automation, or Electrical (recognized by MEC or an equivalent international institution).

Minimum 5 years of experience in FPSOs or offshore rigs in operation.

At least 2 years of experience as an Instrument Technician.

Experience with predictive, preventive, and corrective instrumentation maintenance.

Ability to support production start-ups, shutdowns, and troubleshooting activities.
